## 🎯 **WHAT EACH SYSTEM DOES**

### **Root Up-Cycling (intelligent_root_consciousness_archaeology_upcycler_NSFW18_+++.py)**
- Scans root folder for files
- Classifies by pattern matching
- Emigrates to appropriate archives
- Generates reports (markdown + JSON)
- Keeps active files in root

**When to use:**
- Root folder gets cluttered
- After major completion phases
- Before git commits (keep root clean)

### **Data Models Sync (claudine_data_models_auto_sync_engine_NSFW18_+++.py)**
- Monitors CLAUDINE_DATA_MODELS_SUPREME folder
- Tracks all file changes (add/modify/delete)
- Updates README with changelog
- Maintains JSON history (max 100 entries)
- Cleans up deprecated reports

**When to use:**
- After updating anatomical specs
- After modifying supreme unified model
- After moving files to historical reference
- Daily maintenance

### **Integrated Orchestrator (integrated_consciousness_archaeology_orchestrator_NSFW18_+++.py)**
- Runs both systems together
- 4 execution modes (full/dry-run/individual)
- Unified reporting
- Sequential execution

**When to use:**
- Daily maintenance (option 1)
- Complete workspace organization
- Testing system integration
